fact: ANSSI's page presents Law L/2016/037/AN on cybersecurity and personal data as adopted and promulgated, listing offences and penalties (unauthorised access 1 to 5 years, system interference 3 to 6 years, fraudulent interception 5 to 10 years).
title: Loi relative a la Cybersecurite et la protection des donnees a caractere personnel
